title: CopyrightRadar
tagline: Music check for your Instagram Reels
disclaimer: The risk assessment is not legal advice. Decisions about posts and claims are yours and your lawyer's.
setup_intro: Four steps. The service only reads your Instagram account; it never posts, archives or deletes.
step1_help: At least 10 characters. Only people with this password see the page.
step2_help: Your Instagram account must be a professional account (Business or Creator).
Open developers.facebook.com, create an app and add the Instagram product with Instagram login.
Permission needed: instagram_business_basic only. For your own account Standard Access is enough; no App Review.
If the app is in development mode, add your Instagram account as an Instagram Tester and accept the invite in Instagram.
Generate an access token for your account in the app dashboard and paste it here. It is valid for 60 days; the service renews it.
step3_help: Create an ACRCloud account and an Audio & Video Recognition project of type Audio Fingerprinting.
Copy host (e.g. identify-eu-west-1.acrcloud.com), access key and access secret.
Recognition sends 15-second audio fragments to ACRCloud. Check ACRCloud's data processing terms for your records (DSGVO).
step4_help: Open the main page and press Refresh: the service reads your posts and Meta's copyright check.

Optional but recommended: download your Instagram data (Settings → Your activity → Download your information, format JSON) and import the ZIP on the main page. Meta does not let apps download videos with copyrighted music, so the export is the only way to analyse them.
copyright_yes: Meta returns its copyright check for this account.
copyright_no: Meta did not return its copyright check field for this account. The service works without it.

err.password_rules: Passwords must match and have at least 10 characters.
err.token_invalid: Meta did not accept the token.
err.account_type: This is not a professional Instagram account.
err.acr_key: ACRCloud did not accept the key or secret.
err.graph_failed: Meta's answer was incomplete. Nothing changed.
err.too_many_missing: Too many posts left the feed at once. Nothing changed.
err.not_in_feed: The post is not in the feed.
err.not_marked: The post was not marked by hand.
err.bad_export: This ZIP is not an Instagram export in JSON format.

load_err: Data did not load. Reload the page.
import_done: Export: {files} files, {matched} matched to posts, {added} not in the feed, {archived} in the archive, {without_file} without a media file.
never_checked: Feed not checked with Meta yet.
confirm_mass: {missing} of {feed} posts left the feed at once. Move them to the archive?
result: In feed: {active}. Not in feed: {missing} (new: {newly_missing}). Back in feed: {returned}. New posts: {new_posts}.
still_visible: {still_visible_manual} post(s) you marked as archived are still visible on Instagram.
stats: {feed} in feed · {archive} in archive · {high} high risk in feed
no_meta_field: Meta does not return its copyright check for this account; risk is based on recognition and your review.
no_acr: ACRCloud is not connected: music is not recognised yet (Settings).
demo: Demo mode: invented posts, nothing is real.

high: Commercial label, cover of a known song, or Meta matched a rights holder.
medium: Independent artist or stock music without a licence on file.
unknown: Not analysed, weak match, or no audio available. Needs a check.
low: Safe source (e.g. Facebook Sound Collection) or no music recognised. Listen to be sure.
no_music: No music detected or confirmed by listening.
no_audio: The video has no audio track, or it is a photo.

todo.medium: Decide: keep or archive. Check the licence.

state.missing: not found in feed at check {since}

audio.none: no audio: Meta gives no file for this video. Import the export or upload the file.

reasons.no_audio_track: The video has no audio track.
reasons.meta_safe: Meta: match in a safe source ({src}).
reasons.meta_holder: Meta: match with a rights holder ({src}).
reasons.meta_status: Meta: no match (status: {meta_status}). Meta misses tracks, so this is a weak signal.
reasons.acr_no_match: ACRCloud: not recognised. Fingerprinting misses covers, remixes and music under voice — listen to it.
reasons.acr_cover: ACRCloud: cover of a known song: {artists} – {title} [{label}].
reasons.acr_licensed: ACRCloud: source you hold a licence for: {artists} – {title} [{label}].
reasons.acr_stock: ACRCloud: stock library, no licence on file: {artists} – {title} [{label}].
reasons.acr_independent: ACRCloud: independent or unknown label: {artists} – {title} [{label}], score {score}.
reasons.no_audio_for_recognition: No audio available for recognition. Meta status: {meta_status}.
reasons.not_recognized_yet: Audio is available but was not recognised yet (connect ACRCloud or press Analyse). Meta status: {meta_status}.
